name: Zeus, Thunder Verdict King
loreTies: Zeus embodies sky law, thunder verdicts, kingship, and divine command within The Celestial Heights of Olympus.
The Laurel-Sky Gate allows this deity to enter Ascension-era dungeon routes without collapsing the individuality of other Realms.
Olympian culture, symbols, weapons, and divine law shape every ability, artifact, silhouette, and combat choice.
shortBackstory: Zeus, Thunder Verdict King, is a playable god in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Zeus is the true source-realm divinity behind the mythology — sky law, thunder verdicts, kingship, and divine command. Ascension expands divine power during the current Gate crisis; it does not turn a mortal into a god.

chapters.title: Divine Origin
chapters.text: Zeus is not a mortal hero inspired by myth. Zeus is the actual god recognized by Olympian source culture, born from the supernatural laws of The Celestial Heights of Olympus. Their domain — sky law, thunder verdicts, kingship, and divine command — determines their symbols, weapons, posture, combat instincts, and relationship to sacred authority.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Within Olympian, Zeus expresses the civilization rather than merely representing it. Their visual identity must carry the materials, beauty standards, divine symbols, and sacred rules of The Celestial Heights of Olympus. Their gameplay role, Endurance, must grow from mythology first and mechanics second.

chapters.title: Mythos Gate Wound
chapters.text: During the Ascension era, Zeus can interact with The Laurel-Sky Gate because divine beings are intrinsically connected to their Realms. The Gate does not become a simple teleportation portal; it is a mysterious boundary where separate mythological realities become traversable. Zeus understands some rites of crossing, but not the complete origin of the Mythos Gates.

chapters.title: Dungeon Role
chapters.text: When selected by the player, Zeus enters the dungeon alone as one god or goddess against multiple enemies. No army follows. No squad shares control. Every room, trap, shrine, relic, elite, and boss encounter must test how sky law, thunder verdicts, kingship, and divine command survives pressure from creatures, rival Realm laws, and unstable Gate conditions.

chapters.title: Ascension Conflict
chapters.text: Ascension is the current story arc, not the permanent end-state of the Mythos Gates universe. For Zeus, Ascension means restoration, awakening, evolution, or expansion of existing divine power. Their personal conflict is to recover strength without reducing Olympian mythology into raw fuel for the crisis.

relationshipHooks: Faction witnesses interpret how Zeus crosses The Laurel-Sky Gate.
Rival deities challenge the limits of cross-Realm travel.
Dungeon lore pickups reveal Gate mystery without resolving the full origin.
developmentStatus: Playable deity backstory aligned to Mythos Gates identity, one-deity dungeon runs, current Ascension arc, and preserved Lore Codex canon.
mythicSource: source culture humans later copied as Greek myth
visualCanon: Lyrion is a laurel-envoy of contest law: part diplomat, part oracle usher, part arena architect. His bronze, marble-light, laurel seals, and measured beauty should feel like the origin of later Greek diplomatic and athletic sacred culture.
title: Thunder Verdict King

mythosGatesCanon.identityRule: Zeus is the actual god of Olympian source mythology, never a mortal hero or generic champion.
mythosGatesCanon.arcRule: Ascension restores, awakens, evolves, or expands existing divine power; it does not make the character a god for the first time.
mythosGatesCanon.mysteryRule: The backstory may reveal how this deity interacts with the Mythos Gates, but must not resolve the full origin of the Gates.
